description: The Chief's self-edit tool (bead cx-ebm.60.3; design hq .cmux-scratch/hq6d-multi-chief/DESIGN.md section 6). The brain (optchat-chief) offers it to a Chief's turn only when the Chief's record lists at least one field in self_edit, and answers each call on its own bound daemon connection (principal = the Chief's id) with chief.profile.get, chief.profile.update and chief.profile.avatar.set (cmux-tui/spec/resource-operations-v2.json). The daemon enforces the rule; this text only tells the model. The brain reads this file at build time, so the turn's tool list stays byte-identical while the file does not change.

tool.name: profile
tool.description: Read or change your own Chief profile. With no arguments it returns your record: display_name, role, personality, instructions, avatar, tools, harnesses, engine and self_edit, the fields you may change without asking. Give only fields listed in self_edit; the person changes everything else (ask them in the conversation). avatar_path is a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP file on this machine, at most 1 MiB, that becomes your profile picture; clear_avatar true removes it. You can never change your own tools, harnesses, engine or self_edit; another Chief you change with the chiefs tool, when you have it.

answers.read: The record as chief.profile.get returns it, as JSON text.
answers.changed: The record after the change, as JSON text.
answers.denied: The daemon's chief_self_edit_denied refusal: 'Not allowed: <fields>. Ask the person to change them, or to add them to your self_edit.'
answers.bad_image: 'The picture must be a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP file of at most 1 MiB.'
